failure: Failure: The lower bound is for the entire joint output/reference comparison, not the reduced system channel or a channel diamond norm. The construction prepares no reference and charges no arbitrary-unitary synthesis; initial-reference precision contributes additional error. A fixed-pure-reference overlap optimum is also source-derived but does not imply efficient synthesis.
interface: Interface: All system outputs and the reference are retained; the target contains the same uncorrelated reference. U may be arbitrary subject to exact total-energy conservation. Trace distance is 1/2 trace norm. The upper construction assumes the coherent sine reference is supplied; it is not constructed from free inputs.
